sections.title: Short title.
sections.content: This Act may be called the Laws Local Extent Act, 1874.

sections.title: Interpretation clause.
sections.content:
In this Act the expression “Scheduled Districts” means the territories
mentioned in the sixth schedule hereto annexed.

sections.title: Local extent of Acts in first schedule.
sections.content:
The Acts mentioned in the first schedule hereto annexed
are now in force ^1[in the whole of India except ^2[the territories which, immediately before the
1st November, 1956, were comprised in Part B States] and] the Scheduled Districts.

sections.title: Local extent of enactments in second schedule.
sections.content:
The enactments mentioned in the second
schedule hereto annexed are now in force throughout the whole of the territories now subject to the
government of the Governor of Fort St. George in Council, except the Scheduled Districts subject to such
government.

sections.title: Local extent of enactments in third schedule.
sections.content:
The enactments mentioned in the third schedule
hereto annexed are now in force throughout the whole of the territories now subject to the government of
the Governor of Bombay in Council, except the Scheduled Districts subject to such government.

sections.title: Local extent of enactments in fourth schedule.
sections.content:
The enactments mentioned in the fourth schedule
hereto annexed are now in force throughout the whole of the territories now subject to the government of
the Lieutenant-Governor of Bengal, except the Scheduled Districts subject to such government.

sections.title: Local extent of enactments in fifth schedule.
sections.content:
The enactments mentioned in the fifth schedule
hereto annexed are now in force throughout the whole of the territories now subject to the government of
the Lieutenant-Governor of the North-Western Provinces of the Presidency of Fort William, except the
Scheduled Districts subject to such government.

sections.title: Savings.
